name: buridan-toc-scrollspy-repro
description: jsdom + react-router-dom harness that reproduces the production-rendered TOC link hrefs so the scrollspy setActive logic in app/templates/toc.py can be exercised against the real router shape. react, react-dom, and react-router-dom are pinned to the same versions shipped by the Reflex web app (see reflex.lock/package.json); jsdom is pinned independently to the version below.
